q1.explanationZh: be similar to“与……类似”，to 是介词，后接名词或代词，如 be similar to one another。

q2.explanationZh: be bad for“对……有害”，反义是 be good for；与 be harmful to 意思相同。

q3.explanationZh: “对……熟悉”= be/get familiar to/with：sth. is familiar to sb.（某物为某人所熟悉），sb. is familiar with sth.（某人熟悉某物）。

q4.explanationZh: be proud of“为……而感到自豪”，of 后接让人自豪的人或事。

q5.explanationZh: be located“位于”，后面按地点用 in / on / at；be located in 与 lie in 意思相同。

q6.explanationZh: be fond of“爱好；喜欢”，与 be keen on、enjoy 意思相同，of 后接名词或动名词。

q7.explanationZh: “对某人严格”用 be strict with sb.，如 be strict with oneself（严格要求自己）。

q8.explanationZh: “忙于某事”= be busy with sth.，“忙于做某事”= be busy doing sth.，注意 doing 用动名词。

q9.explanationZh: based on“以……为根据；基于”，常用 be based on，如 Success is based on diligence.

q10.explanationZh: “做某事迟到”= be late for，如 be late for school（上学迟到）。

q11.explanationZh: be responsible for“对……负责”，与 take charge of 意思相同。

q12.explanationZh: be full of“充满”，与 be filled with 意思相同。

q13.explanationZh: “意识到”= be/become aware of，of 后接名词或从句，如 be aware of how you are breathing。

q14.explanationZh: be pleased with“对……满意”，与 be satisfied with、be happy about 意思相同。

q15.explanationZh: be careful with“小心（对待）……”，如 Be careful with this knife.

q16.explanationZh: be surprised at“对……感到惊奇”，at 后接让人吃惊的事，如 be surprised at the news。

q17.explanationZh: be made up of“由……组成”，与 consist of 意思相同，注意不要漏掉 up。

q18.explanationZh: be covered with“被……覆盖”，是被动结构，介词用 with。

accept: be good at / be poor at

q19.explanationZh: “擅长于”= be good at，“对……比较差”= be poor at，两者介词都用 at。

q20.explanationZh: be satisfied with“对……感到满意”，与 be pleased with 意思相同。

q21.explanationZh: be keen on“喜爱”，与 be fond of 意思相同，on 后接名词或动名词。

q22.explanationZh: be ready for“为……作好准备”，与 get ready for、prepare for 意思相同。

q23.explanationZh: be interested in“对……感兴趣”，介词用 in，主语是人。

q24.explanationZh: “出生”= be born，常用过去时 was/were born，后面再接 in + 地点或年份，如 He was born in Shanghai in 1979.

q25.explanationZh: be famous for“以……而著名”，for 后接出名的原因，如 be famous for its night views。

q26.explanationZh: “害怕”= be afraid of；needn’t 是情态动词，后面接动词原形 be。

q27.explanationZh: “生某人的气”= be angry with sb.；last week 表示过去，主语 my father 是单数，所以用 was。

q28.explanationZh: “能够”= be able to + 动词原形；you’ll 是 you will，后面用原形 be。

q29.explanationZh: “小心”= be careful with；这是祈使句，以动词原形 Be 开头，句首大写。

q30.explanationZh: “与……不同”= be different from；主语 textbooks 是复数，一般现在时用 are。

q31.explanationZh: “与……有联系”= be connected to/with；to 是不定式符号，后面用原形 be。

q32.explanationZh: “对……熟悉”：主语是人（drivers），用 be familiar with；should 后接原形 be。

q33.explanationZh: “擅长于”= be good at，at 后接动名词 singing；主语 Tim 是第三人称单数，用 is。

q34.explanationZh: 书末答案印作 is responsible for，但空后是动词原形 arrive，主语 They 是复数，方框里对应的是“应该”= be supposed to；经人工复核（GitHub #135 第 123 条）更正为 are supposed to（“他们应该在 8 点前到校”）。

q35.explanationZh: 课桌仍能看出是木头做的，用 be made of（由……制成）；主语 the desk 是单数，用 is。

q36.sampleAnswer: One should be strict with oneself.
references: One should be strict with oneself.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q36.explanationZh: “严格要求自己”= be strict with oneself；主语 one 对应的反身代词是 oneself；“应该”用 should + 原形 be。

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q37.explanationZh: “建立在……的基础上”= be based on；“勤奋”= diligence，讲普遍道理用一般现在时 is。

q38.sampleAnswer: The Bund is famous for its attractive night views.
references: The Bund is famous for its attractive night views.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q38.explanationZh: “以……而闻名”= be famous for；“外滩”= the Bund，“迷人的夜景”= attractive night views，its 指外滩。

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q39.explanationZh: “属于”= belong to，主语是单数，用 belongs；“坚忍不拔的人”可用 the persevering（the + 形容词表示一类人）。

q40.sampleAnswer: He is keen on all kinds of pop music.
references: He is keen on all kinds of pop music.
He is fond of all kinds of pop music.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q40.explanationZh: “喜爱”= be keen on（也可以说 be fond of）；“各种”= all kinds of，“流行音乐”= pop music。

q41.sampleAnswer: Everyone is able to pass the test as long as he practises hard.
references: Everyone is able to pass the test as long as he practises hard.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q41.explanationZh: “能够”= be able to + 动词原形，everyone 作主语看作单数，用 is；“只要”= as long as。

q42.sampleAnswer: All of us are proud of the great changes in Shanghai. We’re sure Shanghai will be even better tomorrow.
references: All of us are proud of the great changes in Shanghai. We’re sure Shanghai will be even better tomorrow.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q42.explanationZh: “为……而感到骄傲”= be proud of；“我们相信……”= We’re sure …；“更好”用 even better 加强比较级。

q43.sampleAnswer: The Oriental Pearl TV Tower is familiar to all Shanghai citizens.
references: The Oriental Pearl TV Tower is familiar to all Shanghai citizens.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q43.explanationZh: 物作主语、表示“为某人所熟悉”用 be familiar to sb.；“东方明珠电视塔”= the Oriental Pearl TV Tower。

q44.sampleAnswer: Helen’s teacher was so pleased with the great progress she made this term.
references: Helen’s teacher was so pleased with the great progress she made this term.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q44.explanationZh: “对……满意”= be pleased with；“取得进步”= make progress，progress 不可数；这学期已经取得的进步，用过去时 was、made。

q45.sampleAnswer: Many students have to give up their hobbies because they are busy with their studies.
references: Many students have to give up their hobbies because they are busy with their studies.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q45.explanationZh: “忙于某事”= be busy with sth.；“不得不”= have to，“放弃”= give up；because 引出原因。
